item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 53a72f8c9; routing.py adds the raise_on_unavailable opt-out, the unavailable classification with its withheld reason and removes the blanket git worktree prune, with the test and the landing fragment beside it.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete with commits 0c72d3604 and 038c7e85b, baseline_suite and after_suite both completed=true with failure_count 0, negative_control_log and its note present.

justifications.durability: the negative control reinstates the raise and both gate cases redden (2 failed EXIT=1, independently reproduced at the base module), and each assertion reads an independent source - git registration, _tree_state detail, on-disk existence.
justifications.evidence: the gate measures the done-when and its result is recorded in the manifest and its logs; an independent re-run reproduced the base defect (CrewError at routing.py:668, both gate cases red) and the head pass (2 passed).
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:832 follows the module's existing withheld-reason pattern beside RUN_DIRECTORY_EXTRACTION_REASON, and neither the source nor the test file carries a plan label or a plan referent.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:668 keeps the raise for promotion's two callers while routing.py:946 opts gc out, so gc reports the vanished tree and reclaims the rest exactly as the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in diff 53a72f8c9..038c7e85b is inside the three declared write paths, with no edit to any other file, shared index, sprint or plan state.
